notes: MXB Race Day Live v0.5.13 refines the profile-first interface into a focused race-night layout inspired by the supplied direction without copying it or adding unnecessary dashboard clutter. The rider profile remains the landing page with the existing banner/avatar identity, a compact career strip, My Races, next-race and latest-result panels. Primary navigation is limited to Profile, Find a Race, Championships, Garage, Live and Results; Wallet, Rankings, Profile Settings, Membership, MX Bikes tools, updates and Admin are moved into a compact MENU dropdown. Windows identity is also reworked at the process level: MXB Race Day Live.exe now hosts the application in-process instead of spawning pythonw.exe, the custom icon is embedded directly into the branded executable, desktop/existing pinned links target that executable and use its embedded icon, and the old explicit Python-era AppUserModelID override is removed. The v0.5.13 update performs a one-time relaunch into the new branded host after installation.
